chapterInfo.content:
18
Ɔtemmufoɔ a ɔntene no
1 # Rom 12.12; Kol 4.2; 1 Te 5.17 Na ɔbuu wɔn bɛ bi de kyerɛɛ sɛ ɛtwa sɛ nnipa bɔ mpaeɛ daa a wɔmmrɛ ho: 2Ɔtemmufoɔ bi tenaa kuro bi mu a ɔnsuro Onyankopɔn, nanso ɔmfɛre nnipa. 3Na okunafoɔ bi nso tenaa kuro no mu, na ɔbaa ne nkyɛn sɛ: Bu atɛn gye me me tamfo nsam! 4Na wampene maa no kyɛree kakra. Na akyire yi ɔkaa ne tirim sɛ: Mensuro Onyankopɔn na memfɛre nnipa deɛ, 5#Luka 11.7-8 nanso okunafoɔ yi ha me nti, mɛbu atɛn mama no, na wamfa ne ba a ɔba ha daa no ammɛdwan me ho. 6Na Awurade se: Montie deɛ ɔtemmufoɔ a ɔntene yi ka! 7Na Onyankopɔn, sɛ ɔto ne bo ase kyɛre wɔn ho nso a, ɔremmu atɛn nnye wɔn a wayi wɔn a wɔsu frɛ no awia ne anadwo no anaa? 8Mese mo sɛ, ɔbɛbu atɛn agye wɔn ntɛm. Nanso Onipa Ba no ba a, anka ɔbɛhunu gyidie asase so?
Farisini ne ɔtogyeni no
9Na ɔbuu binom a wɔde wɔn ho too wɔn ho soɔ sɛ wɔtene na wɔmmu wɔn a aka no bɛ yi sɛ: 10Nnipa baanu kɔɔ asɔrefie mpaebɔ; ɔbaako yɛ Farisini, na ɔbaako yɛ ɔtogyeni. 11#Yes 58.2-3 Farisini no gyinae, na ɔbɔɔ mpaeɛ ne tirim sɛ: Onyankopɔn, meda wo ase sɛ mente sɛdeɛ nnipa a aka no teɛ: Amimfoɔ, nkontompofoɔ, ayerefafoɔ anaa ɔtogyeni yi mpo. 12#Mat 23.23 Medi mmuada dapɛn mu mprenu, mede deɛ menya nyinaa so ntotosoɔ du du mema.
13 # Dwom 51.1 Na ɔtogyeni no deɛ, ɔgyinaa akyirikyiri, na wampɛ sɛ ɔma n’ani so kyerɛ soro mpo, na mmom ɔbɔɔ ne koko so kaa sɛ: Onyankopɔn, hu me debɔneyɛni mmɔbɔ! 14#Luka 14.11; Mat 23.12 Mese mo sɛ: Oyi de bem sane kɔɔ ne fie mmom sene ɔbaako no; na obiara a ɔma ne ho soɔ no, wɔbɛbrɛ no ase, na deɛ ɔbrɛ ne ho aseɛ no, wɔbɛma no so.
Yesu hyira mmɔfra
(Mateo 19.13-15; Marko 10.13-16)
15Na wɔde nkɔkoaa nso brɛɛ no sɛ ɔmfa ne nsa nka wɔn; na asuafoɔ no hunuiɛ no, wɔkaa wɔn anim. 16Na Yesu frɛɛ mmɔfra no bae, see asuafoɔ no sɛ: Momma mmɔfra no mmra me nkyɛn, na monnsi wɔn kwan! Na yeinom sɛɛ na Nyankopɔn ahennie no wɔ wɔn. 17#Mat 18.3 Nokorɛ mese mo sɛ, obiara a ɔrennye Nyankopɔn ahennie sɛ abɔfra no, ɔrenkɔ mu koraa.
Daa nkwa
(Mateo 19.16-29; Marko 10.17-30)
18Na ɔpanin bi bisaa no sɛ: Kyerɛkyerɛfoɔ pa, ɛdeɛn na menyɛ na manya daa nkwa? 19Na Yesu see no sɛ: Adɛn na wofrɛ me papa? Obiara nyɛ papa gye ɔbaako, ɔne Onyankopɔn. 20#Eks 20.12-16 Wonim mmara nsɛm no: Nsɛe awadeɛ! Nni awu! Mmɔ korɔno! Nni adansekurumu! Di w’agya ne wo na ni! 21Na ɔkaa sɛ: Yeinom nyinaa, mefiri me mmɔfraase na medii soɔ. 22#Mat 6.20 Na Yesu tee saa no, ɔsee no sɛ: Ɛda so ka wo adeɛ baako, kɔtɔn deɛ wowɔ nyinaa, na kyɛ ma ahiafoɔ, na wobɛnya agyapadeɛ wɔ soro, na bra bɛdi m’akyi! 23Na ɔtee yei no, ɛyɛɛ no awerɛho sɛ; ɛfiri sɛ na ɔyɛ ɔdefoɔ kɛseɛ.
Ahonyadeɛ mu asiane
24Na Yesu hwɛɛ no kaa sɛ: Sɛ moahunu den a ɛyɛ ma asikafoɔ ne adefoɔ sɛ wɔbɛkɔ Nyankopɔn ahennie mu! 25Na ɛyɛ mmerɛ ma yoma sɛ ɔbɛfa paneɛ aniwa mu sene sɛ ɔdefoɔ bɛkɔ Nyankopɔn ahennie mu. 26Na wɔn a wɔteeɛ no kaa sɛ: Ɛnneɛ hwan na wɔbɛtumi agye no nkwa? 27Na ɔkaa sɛ: Deɛ ɛntumi nyɛ hɔ nnipa fam no, Nyankopɔn fam deɛ, ɛbɛtumi ayɛ hɔ.
Ahopakyire so akatua
28Na Petro se: Hwɛ, yɛagya ade nyinaa hɔ abɛdi w’akyi. 29Na ɔsee wɔn sɛ: Nokorɛ mese mo sɛ: Obi nni hɔ a wagya efie anaa yerɛ anaa anuanom anaa awofoɔ anaa mma hɔ Nyankopɔn ahennie nti, 30na ɔrennya no mmɔho pii ɛberɛ yi mu ne wiase a ɛreba no mu daa nkwa.
Yesu wuo ne ne wusɔreɛ ho nkɔmhyɛ a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa
(Mateo 20.17-19; Marko 10.32-34)
31 # Luka 9.22; 9.44 Na ɔfaa dummienu no ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Hwɛ, yɛrekɔ Yerusalem, na nnoɔma a adiyifoɔ no atwerɛ afa onipa ba no ho nyinaa bɛba mu. 32Na wɔbɛyi no ahyɛ wiase aman sofoɔ nsa, na wɔagoro ne ho, na wɔabɔ no adapaa, na wɔatete ntasuo agu ne so, 33na wɔaka no mpire, na wɔakum no, na da a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa no, wasɔre bio. 34#Mar 9.32 Na wɔn deɛ, wɔante yeinom biara ase, na asɛm yi ahunta wɔn, na wɔanhunu deɛ ɔkaeɛ no.
Onifirani bi adehunu
(Mateo 20.29-34; Marko 10.46-52)
35Na ɛbaa sɛ ɔrebɛn Yeriko no, na onifirani bi te kwankyɛn resrɛsrɛ adeɛ. 36Na ɔtee sɛ nkurɔfokuo bi retwam no, ɔbisaa aseɛ. 37Na wɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ, Yesu Nasareni no na ɔretwam. 38Na ɔteaa mu sɛ: Yesu, Dawid ba, hu me mmɔbɔ! 39Na wɔn a wɔdi kan no kaa n’anim sɛ ɔmmua n’ano; nanso ɔkɔɔ so teateaa mu denden sɛ: Dawid ba, hu me mmɔbɔ! 40Na Yesu gyina hyɛɛ sɛ wɔmfa no mmrɛ no. Na ɔbɛneeɛ no, ɔbisaa no 41sɛ: Ɛdeɛn na wopɛ sɛ meyɛ mema woɔ? Na ɔkaa sɛ: Awurade, ma menhunu adeɛ. 42#Luka 17.19 Na Yesu see no sɛ: Hunu adeɛ! Wo gyidie agye wo. 43Na amonom hɔ ara, ɔhunuu adeɛ, na ɔdii n’akyi de animuonyam maa Onyankopɔn. Na ɔman no nyinaa hunuiɛ no, wɔde ayeyie maa Onyankopɔn.

Na ɔpanin bi bisaa no sɛ: Kyerɛkyerɛfoɔ pa, ɛdeɛn na menyɛ na manya daa nkwa? Na Yesu see no sɛ: Adɛn na wofrɛ me papa? Obiara nyɛ papa gye ɔbaako, ɔne Onyankopɔn. Wonim mmara nsɛm no: Nsɛe awadeɛ! app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
